selectedTarget.basis: Inspected native target picker, Scapegoat response and resolved removal

setup.scope: Controlled hand/deck entry swap, not naturally reached gameplay. Whole original entries and inventory are preserved.

managedScope: Discard/target commitment only, before response/chain resolution
limitations: MST uses a logged controlled initial hand/deck entry exchange; Vortex has no RAM setup.
MST menu initially retains a stale Vortex image; placement prompt, canonical source ID and target effect identify MST.
Native chain/Scapegoat behavior is research evidence, not implemented C# effect resolution.
Destroyed/returned/replaced target, leave/re-enter, negation and refund behavior are not established by this experiment.
Managed placement tokens, command/revision semantics, atomicity and combined-cost/target profile are synthetic contracts.
Card-detail/chain UI interpretation is manual; hashes validate retained frames, not OCR.
Savestate load helper reports were retained in tool output, not complete debugger load transcripts.
